package android.system

import java.io.FileDescriptor
import java.io.IOException
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.channels.FileChannel
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS
import java.nio.file.OpenOption
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption

/** Narrow JVM OS simulation using real host files/FDs. NOT Android/SELinux validation.
 * NOFOLLOW is checked before host opens: this fixture does not model a kernel race. */
class ErrnoException(val functionName: String, val errno: Int) : Exception("$functionName errno=$errno")
class StructStat(val st_mode: Int, val st_nlink: Long, val st_size: Long, val st_dev: Long, val st_ino: Long)
class StructStatVfs(val f_frsize: Long, val f_bavail: Long)
object OsConstants {
    const val O_RDONLY = 0; const val O_WRONLY = 1; const val O_CREAT = 64
    const val O_EXCL = 128; const val O_NONBLOCK = 2048; const val O_DIRECTORY = 65536
    const val O_NOFOLLOW = 131072; const val O_CLOEXEC = 524288
    const val ENOENT = 2; const val EACCES = 13; const val EIO = 5
    const val ELOOP = 40; const val ENOTDIR = 20; const val EEXIST = 17
    const val EPERM = 1; const val EOPNOTSUPP = 95; const val ENOSYS = 38; const val EINVAL = 22
    fun S_ISDIR(mode: Int) = mode and 61440 == 16384
    fun S_ISREG(mode: Int) = mode and 61440 == 32768
}
object Os {
    data class OpenCall(val path: String, val flags: Int)
    val opens = mutableListOf<OpenCall>()
    val deniedAncestors = mutableSetOf<String>()
    var deniedAttempts = 0
    var failOperation: String? = null
    var failAfterMatchingCalls = 0
    var failErrno = OsConstants.EIO
    var beforeLink: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    var linkCalls = 0
    var renameCalls = 0
    var fstatvfsCalls = 0
    var statvfsCalls = 0
    var requireFdSpaceQuery = false
    var statCalls = 0
    var fstatCalls = 0
    val noHardlinkRoots = mutableSetOf<String>()
    val deniedHardlinkRoots = mutableSetOf<String>()
    var deniedHardlinkAttempts = 0
    val ignoredChmodRoots = mutableSetOf<String>()
    private fun below(path: String, roots: Set<String>): Boolean {
        val actual = Path.of(path).toRealPath().toString()
        return roots.any { actual == it || actual.startsWith(it + "/") }
    }
    private val channels = java.util.IdentityHashMap<FileDescriptor, FileChannel>()
    private val fdField = FileDescriptor::class.java.getDeclaredField("fd").apply { isAccessible = true }
    private val channelFd = Class.forName("sun.nio.ch.FileChannelImpl").getDeclaredField("fd").apply { isAccessible = true }
    val liveDescriptors: Int get() = channels.size
    fun number(fd: FileDescriptor) = fdField.getInt(fd)
    private fun fault(operation: String) {
        if (failOperation == operation) {
            if (failAfterMatchingCalls > 0) { failAfterMatchingCalls--; return }
            failOperation = null
            val errno = failErrno; failErrno = OsConstants.EIO
            throw ErrnoException(operation, errno)
        }
    }
    private inline fun <T> translated(operation: String, action: () -> T): T = try { action() }
        catch (e: ErrnoException) { throw e }
        catch (e: java.nio.file.NoSuchFileException) { throw ErrnoException(operation, OsConstants.ENOENT) }
        catch (e: java.nio.file.FileAlreadyExistsException) { throw ErrnoException(operation, OsConstants.EEXIST) }
        catch (e: IOException) { throw ErrnoException(operation, OsConstants.EIO) }
    fun open(path: String, flags: Int, mode: Int): FileDescriptor = translated("open") {
        opens += OpenCall(path, flags)
        fault("open")
        val p = Path.of(path)
        if (p.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString() in deniedAncestors) {
            deniedAttempts++; throw ErrnoException("open", OsConstants.EACCES)
        }
        if (flags and OsConstants.O_NOFOLLOW != 0 && Files.isSymbolicLink(p)) throw ErrnoException("open", OsConstants.ELOOP)
        if (flags and OsConstants.O_DIRECTORY != 0 && !Files.isDirectory(p)) throw ErrnoException("open", OsConstants.ENOTDIR)
        val options = mutableSetOf<OpenOption>(if (flags and OsConstants.O_WRONLY != 0) StandardOpenOption.WRITE else StandardOpenOption.READ)
        if (flags and OsConstants.O_CREAT != 0) options += if (flags and OsConstants.O_EXCL != 0) StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW else StandardOpenOption.CREATE
        // Passing NOFOLLOW to the host provider also protects the final component at open time.
        if (flags and OsConstants.O_NOFOLLOW != 0) options += NOFOLLOW_LINKS
        val channel = FileChannel.open(p, options)
        val fd = channelFd.get(channel) as FileDescriptor
        channels[fd] = channel
        if (flags and OsConstants.O_CREAT != 0) Files.setAttribute(p, "unix:mode", mode)
        fd
    }
    fun dup(fd: FileDescriptor): FileDescriptor {
        fault("dup")
        // Reopen the real procfd only in this test stub; production duplication uses Android PFD.
        return open("/proc/self/fd/${number(fd)}", 0, 0)
    }
    fun close(fd: FileDescriptor) { channels.remove(fd)?.close() ?: error("double close/unknown FD") }
    fun lstat(path: String): StructStat = translated("lstat") {
        statCalls++; fault("lstat"); attributes(Path.of(path), false)
    }
    fun fstat(fd: FileDescriptor): StructStat = translated("fstat") {
        fstatCalls++; fault("fstat"); attributes(Path.of("/proc/self/fd/${number(fd)}"), true)
    }
    private fun attributes(path: Path, follow: Boolean): StructStat {
        val options = if (follow) emptyArray() else arrayOf(NOFOLLOW_LINKS)
        val attrs = Files.readAttributes(path, "unix:mode,nlink,size,dev,ino", *options)
        return StructStat(attrs["mode"] as Int, (attrs["nlink"] as Number).toLong(), (attrs["size"] as Number).toLong(),
            (attrs["dev"] as Number).toLong(), (attrs["ino"] as Number).toLong())
    }
    fun read(fd: FileDescriptor, bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int, count: Int): Int {
        fault("read"); return channels.getValue(fd).read(ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes, offset, count))
    }
    fun write(fd: FileDescriptor, bytes: ByteArray, offset: Int, count: Int): Int {
        fault("write"); return channels.getValue(fd).write(ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes, offset, count))
    }
    fun mkdir(path: String, mode: Int) = translated("mkdir") {
        fault("mkdir"); Files.createDirectory(Path.of(path)); Files.setAttribute(Path.of(path), "unix:mode", mode); Unit
    }
    fun fchmod(fd: FileDescriptor, mode: Int) { fault("fchmod"); val path = "/proc/self/fd/${number(fd)}"; if (!below(path, ignoredChmodRoots)) Files.setAttribute(Path.of(path), "unix:mode", mode) }
    fun fsync(fd: FileDescriptor) { fault("fsync"); channels.getValue(fd).force(true) }
    fun rename(from: String, to: String) = translated("rename") {
        renameCalls++; fault("rename"); Files.move(Path.of(from), Path.of(to), ATOMIC_MOVE, REPLACE_EXISTING); Unit
    }
    fun remove(path: String) = translated("remove") { fault("remove"); Files.delete(Path.of(path)); Unit }
    fun unlink(path: String) = translated("unlink") { fault("unlink"); Files.delete(Path.of(path)); Unit }
    fun link(from: String, to: String) = translated("link") {
        linkCalls++
        beforeLink?.also { beforeLink = null; it(to) }
        fault("link")
        if (below(from, deniedHardlinkRoots)) {
            deniedHardlinkAttempts++; throw ErrnoException("link", OsConstants.EACCES)
        }
        if (below(from, noHardlinkRoots)) throw ErrnoException("link", OsConstants.EOPNOTSUPP)
        Files.createLink(Path.of(to), Path.of(from)); Unit
    }
    fun rmdir(path: String) = translated("rmdir") {
        fault("rmdir"); check(Files.isDirectory(Path.of(path), NOFOLLOW_LINKS)); Files.delete(Path.of(path)); Unit
    }
    fun statvfs(path: String): StructStatVfs {
        statvfsCalls++; fault("statvfs")
        if (requireFdSpaceQuery) throw ErrnoException("statvfs", OsConstants.EACCES)
        return StructStatVfs(1, Files.getFileStore(Path.of(path)).usableSpace)
    }
    fun fstatvfs(fd: FileDescriptor): StructStatVfs = translated("fstatvfs") {
        fstatvfsCalls++; fault("fstatvfs")
        check(channels.containsKey(fd)) { "fstatvfs requires a live owned descriptor" }
        StructStatVfs(1, Files.getFileStore(Path.of("/proc/self/fd/${number(fd)}")).usableSpace)
    }
}
